gaps.description: The 2026-09-08 reevaluation plan lists parent input as information to be gathered for the reevaluation. None of the later supplied documents (psychoeducational reevaluation, academic reevaluation, speech-language review, reevaluation eligibility determination, reevaluation IEP) records parent input or lists it among the sources reviewed. A record of the parent input gathered would answer this.

tripwires.description: L002 reviewed reference has zero conflicts; grader must not accept conflict claims.
Reading Fluency (2023) vs Reading Comprehension (2026) primary need change is longitudinal, not a conflict.
62 to 91 to 104 WCPM over time is progress/measurement change, not a conflict.
Prior fluency annual goal vs later comprehension goal is a plan change, not a conflict.
Grade 2 to 3 to 5 across school years is expected progression, not a conflict.
Annual vs quarterly progress reporting change between IEPs is not a conflict.
Extended-time continuing while text-to-speech is added in the later IEP is not a conflict.
